title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
summary: Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit.

title: ‘Roadmap is Complete,' Cardano Founder Charles Hoskinson Says
summary: Cardano's ADA token is down almost 95% from its all-time high, and investors don't seem to be happy that the roadmap is complete.

summary: Nvidia’s founder is out, and tech and crypto leaders are fuming. Some fear for open-source AI, others question the board, while Elon Musk says he’d be honored to hire Huang.
